_comment: CAPABILITY suite: ONE Kafka stream publisher consuming THREE topics, TWO of them written and ONE never. Functions in functions/caps_kafka_topics.py::kafka_two_of_three: its topic is the regex ^<prefix>\.(departments|employees|titles)$, every frame routed to its topic's table by its columns (kafka_departments, kafka_employees, kafka_titles), anything else to kafka_unrouted. The silent topic EXISTS -- a redpanda domain's create-model creates every entity's topic -- so the subscription holds it from the start and it simply carries nothing. STAGES: (1) domains -- a redpanda domain with the employees model and no seed (create-data would write every topic); (2) actions, tagged live -- `produce` in the background: 6 passes 15s apart of `modify-data --entity departments,employees`, each appended to ${xp:dir}/ops.jsonl, running while (3) the collection is created and (4) the publisher registered, which STARTS it; (5) actions -- wait for produce, then scripts/verify_kafka.py, tagged check: every message of departments and employees in its table exactly once (polling, at most 5m), and kafka_titles and kafka_unrouted without a row; (6) monitor. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite kafka/kafka_multi_topic_silent --keep`.
